title: Output mapping (topic ul/v1/d/{id}/config, retained, QoS 1, server to device)
description: How the board's channels group into outputs. If no config is retained the device uses the default mapping: one output per channel, key = channel id, pwm -> white, argb -> argb, switch -> relay, motion -> motion. The device stores the last applied config in NVS.

rev.description: Increases on every change; echoed as config_rev in info.
